sloka: प्रत्यूचुस्तां ततो देवा यथा वदसि दुर्वसे ।तथा भवतु तत्सर्वं साधयस्व यदीप्सितम् ।। ७.८६.१७ ॥
transliteration: pratyūcustāṁ tato devā yathā vadasi durvase ।tathā bhavatu tatsarvaṁ sādhayasva yadīpsitam ।। 7.86.17 ॥

translations.english: Then the gods replied to him, "O sage, as you say, so let it be; accomplish all that is desired."
